# Ivan Dimitrijevic / TrustPress AI

This site contains public authority assets, books, executive editions, and frameworks by Ivan Dimitrijevic, Natasa Dimitrijevic, and TrustPress AI.

## Important pages

- Trust, Shortlist, Pipeline: https://ivandimitry.github.io/
- TrustPress AI: https://ivandimitry.github.io/trustpress-ai/

## Key book

### Trust, Shortlist, Pipeline
Subtitle: How B2B Teams Build Market Memory in the AI Era
Author: Ivan Dimitrijevic
URL: https://ivandimitry.github.io/
PDF: https://ivandimitry.github.io/trust-shortlist-pipeline.pdf

Core topics:
- B2B trust

## TrustPress AI

TrustPress AI is an AI-assisted authority publishing studio founded by Ivan Dimitrijevic and Natasa Dimitrijevic. It helps founders, experts, and B2B teams turn raw expertise into books, executive editions, public authority assets, and distribution systems.

Core topics:
- AI publishing
- authority assets
- thought leadership books
- expert positioning
- book production systems
- executive editions
- LinkedIn distribution
- AI-search-friendly publishing
- market memory
